considered_rates.assessment: US 10Y 4.94 is near the 1y 97.8th percentile with a 45.000000000000014bp 3m change; AU 2Y 4.835 sits at the 99.8th 1y percentile while Australian housing is tightening.
US 2s10s is 27.000000000000046bp at the 1.4th 1y percentile, so curve is an executable alternative to spot or outright duration.
CA-US 5Y is -122.00000000000001bp at the 0.2th 1y percentile — a historically extreme cross-market RV object.

considered_spot.assessment: Spot is the usual CAD expression; it is inferior here because the catalyst is a local reaction-function sentence.

remit: credible path from mispricing to repricing
stance_summary: BoC energy pass-through is a dated mechanism; paying CAN 2Y is cleaner than hoping USDCAD reprices it.
